activities.name: Drink and listen
activities.blurb: Nurse a cup where every conversation in the room overlaps.

activities.name: Sit in with the gamblers
activities.blurb: Bone dice, real stakes, the corner booth.

activities.name: Work the taps
activities.blurb: Pour, mop, and hear the parish told twice at volume.

events.text: A narrow man in good cloth drinks alone, growing looser by the cup. The innkeep murmurs that he is the lord's own steward, down from the castle and far from sober.

effect.text: You keep his cup full and your questions light. By closing he counts you a friend — and friends of the steward, he says, are never turned away at the castle gate.
effect.outcome: drank the lord's steward under the table and made a friend at the castle.

events.text: The steward is back, soberer tonight, and he remembers you kindly.

effect.text: He lets slip what the lord will and won't hear at the fair-day court — worth more than the ale it cost you.
effect.outcome: traded ale for the steward's read on the lord's moods.

events.text: The dice are bone and the stakes are real. You buy in and the table reads you like a ledger.

pass.text: Quick fingers, quicker eyes. You rise two pennies richer and earn a nod that's worth more than the coin.
pass.outcome: out-played the tavern gamblers and pocketed the winnings.

fail.text: The dice run cold. The innkeep covers your last call and writes it on the slate without being asked.
fail.outcome: lost to the gamblers and went on the innkeep's slate.

events.text: The innkeep hands you an apron without a word and tilts her head at the slate with your name on it.

effect.text: Six hours of pouring later, she draws a line through your debt and, rarer still, gives you a nod.
effect.outcome: worked the slate clean and earned the innkeep's nod.

events.text: The room is thirsty and the night is young. A few coins would buy you the whole tavern's goodwill — or you could keep your purse and your wits.

choices.label: Stand a round for the room

effect.text: Coins on the bar like a lord. The room cheers your name twice and forgets it once, and the innkeep opens a fresh line on the slate.
effect.outcome: stood the whole tavern a round — beloved, broke, and on the slate.

choices.label: Keep your coin and your corner

effect.text: You nurse one cup and let the room buy its own. Nobody sings your name, but nobody holds your purse either.
effect.outcome: kept to a quiet corner and kept their coin.

events.text: The taps don't pour themselves and the innkeep is two hands short.

effect.text: Honest work, honest coin, and the better wage of hearing everything in the parish before it's true.
effect.outcome: worked the tavern taps till closing and heard the week's secrets twice.

events.text: A drover takes against your face and the room clears a circle. There's no talking out of this one.

pass.text: One clean swing settles it. The drover buys the apology in ale and the room toasts you.
pass.outcome: won a tavern brawl in one swing and drank free for it.

fail.text: He's wider than he looked. You give as good as you get but leave by the side door with a ringing ear.
fail.outcome: lost a tavern brawl and left by the side door.

events.text: A scarred woman buys you a drink and asks, very quietly, whether you've ever wanted to leave Hollowbrook for good — and for coin.

pass.text: You hear her out, learn what the foreign ship really carries, and walk away owing nothing. Knowledge for the price of a listen.
pass.outcome: heard out a recruiter and learned what the foreign ship really carries.

fail.text: Her offer is sweeter than it should be and you find yourself half-promised before you catch it. Untangling takes the rest of the night.
fail.outcome: nearly signed away the week to a recruiter before thinking better of it.
